summary: Iteration 2 (earnings/withdrawals, e-prescriptions, e-invoices) fully tested. Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass. Frontend: doctor 4-tab layout, earnings dashboard + withdraw modal, prescription editor/view, invoice view, and tracking-completed actions all render and integrate correctly with the backend.

issues: RN Web deprecation warnings: 'shadow*' style props and props.pointerEvents (non-blocking, should migrate to boxShadow/style.pointerEvents)

action_items: (Low priority) Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow and props.pointerEvents to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web warnings.

(Optional) The /doctor/prescription/[visitId] screen does not pre-populate existing prescription data when reopened to 'Edit' — if edit-in-place is desired, the form should fetch and hydrate from GET /api/visits/{id}/prescription. Not blocking; upsert works on save.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~630 lines — approaching the 700-line split threshold. Consider extracting prescriptions/invoices/earnings into separate routers in the next iteration.
Earnings 'this_week_*' uses completed[-7:] (last 7 visits), not calendar-week filtering. Field name is slightly misleading; consider renaming to 'recent_*' or filtering by timestamp >= now-7d.
ensure_invoice uses visit['fee'] with fallback 1499; safe, but if a doctor has a different fee the fallback could silently understate. Fine since accept_visit always sets fee.
Withdrawal status is hard-coded 'pending' with no admin endpoint to mark 'completed' — acknowledged as mocked per spec.
seed_data_creation: Tests created several TEST_P_* patients and ~5 completed visits on doc-1 plus 3 pending withdrawals (₹100, ₹100, ₹500) on doc-1. doc-1 earnings state after run: available ₹5,671, pending_withdrawal ₹700, visits_completed 5, total_earned ₹7,495.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL = EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (symptom-check-20...). For frontend login on web preview use data-testid selectors: role-selector-doctor, login-name-input, login-continue-button. page.keyboard.type works better than fill for RN TextInput. Doctor portal tabs: Feed/Active/Earnings/Profile. Earnings testIDs: available-balance-card, withdraw-button, withdraw-amount-input, confirm-withdraw. Active job testIDs: write-rx-{visitId}, advance-button-{visitId}. doc-1 has seeded earnings state from this run (available ~5671); rerunning withdrawal tests will continue to consume available balance.
